annotation.title_clean: Setting up a special committee on artificial intelligence in a digital age, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office
annotation.title_en: Setting up a special committee on artificial intelligence in a digital age, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 362
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament decision of 18 June 2020 establishing a 33-member special committee on AI in a digital age with a 12-month term. It will analyse AI's economic impact, assess third-country approaches, and propose common EU objectives, starting from the Commission's February 2020 digital, data, AI white paper and safety/liability communications.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets up a special committee on AI in a digital age with 33 Members
Term of office of 12 months from constituent meeting
Analyses AI's impact on the economy across sectors and third-country approaches
Must define common EU medium- and long-term objectives based on Commission's February 2020 communications
Produces a final report with findings and recommendations without prejudice to standing committees' competences
